claims.evidence: Witness photos show a black UPS branded “BLUE GATE” with a front control/power panel and cables/plug visible.
No photo shows battery label/age, replacement date, or internal battery compartment.
No photo/video shows runtime test under load or battery discharge measurement.
No photo shows internal inspection, repair seals, or evidence of prior servicing.

risks.risk: Battery capacity may be overstated; runtime could be far less than claimed, especially under real load.
risks.proof: A short video of the UPS running on battery with a known load (e.g., a wattmeter reading) and a timer showing runtime until shutdown.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used UPS with unknown battery health (worst case: weak battery / short runtime).

risks.risk: UPS may not switch correctly to backup mode or may have faulty inverter/charger.
risks.proof: A clip showing mains power ON, then mains unplugged while the UPS continues powering a load (no drop, no error codes).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully verified for proper backup operation.

risks.risk: Capacity (VA/W) and outlet configuration are unknown; wrong sizing can make it unusable for the buyer’s devices.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the rating label (VA/W), model/serial, and a shot of all outlets/ports.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest practical tier for an unverified UPS capacity.

risks.risk: Physical/port wear or internal damage may exist (ventilation, back-panel ports, corrosion, loose connectors).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the back panel/ports, ventilation grilles, and any visible damage or discoloration.
risks.if_unproven: Price as having potential cosmetic/connection wear typical of used units.

risks.risk: Accessories and completeness may be missing (manual, power cable, mounting, any required leads).
risks.proof: A photo inventory showing included items (manual, cables, any mounting brackets, warranty card if any).

proof_requests: Clear photo of the UPS rating label showing VA/W, model number, and serial number.
Video test: mains ON powering a load, then mains unplugged; show UPS stays on and any status/error indicators.
Battery runtime proof: discharge test with a known watt load and a visible timer (until UPS switches off).
Close-up photos of back panel/ports, ventilation, and any signs of repair or tampering.
Photos of included accessories (power cable, manual, mounting items, warranty info if present).
response.reason: The witness can identify the item as a BLUE GATE UPS, so it can be priced at a worst-case assumption for battery health and verified operation since the key performance details are not shown.
